In the glittering summer of 1922, mysterious millionaire Jay Gatsby throws extravagant parties in his Long Island mansion, all in a desperate bid to win back his former lover, Daisy Buchanan. As narrator Nick Carraway is drawn into Gatsby's opulent world of Jazz Age excess, he witnesses the intoxicating allure and ultimate corruption of the American Dream. Beneath the shimmering facade of champagne and neon lies a haunting tragedy of unrequited longing, deceit, and the impossibility of repeating the past.
